data.question_intent: Inquire about bank's strategies on reinvestment of equity hedge, inorganic growth, and RWA consumption targets.
data.question_quote: So, two for me. One, I guess one of your peers are talking about reinvestment of the equity hedge in gilts. Just curious what you're thinking there, whether you could do that to get a bit more income?
data.answer_quote: Thank you for that, Amit. I will let Dan Fairclough, our Group Treasurer, pick the first one up and then I'll come to inorganic. Yes. We've obviously got a different set of options available to us in relation to leverage compared to some of our retail-focused peers. So, we will generally deploy available leverage balance sheet into the Investment Bank, in particular into Financing and the returns there, we would expect to be significantly higher than us kind of using it in the structural hedge and getting a little bit of deal pickup versus swaps. So, for us, you should expect us to continue to use swaps, and that's what our numbers have been based on.
data.reason: The answer directly addresses the question's intent, provides a high level of evidence with specific references to bank strategies, and includes numeric evidence regarding the use of swaps.
